feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: The Ebola crisis is far outpacing the response, Congo's IRC director says
entry.summary: Health workers battling the ongoing Ebola outbreak in Congo are hindered by lack of data, budget cuts and a fearful community.

entry.title: A new poll shows what voters are thinking 2 weeks out from Election Day
entry.summary: Midterm election day is just over two weeks away. What are some numbers on the mind of voters?

entry.title: Alberta voters decide whether to take a step toward separating from Canada
entry.summary: In Canada, the oil-rich province of Alberta votes in a referendum that could set it on a path toward separation, as Prime Minister Mark Carney warns of threats to Canadian unity.

entry.title: Wisconsin has one of the most competitive races for governor
entry.summary: Governors have been key in blocking or fulfilling the Trump agenda and 36 governors offices are up for election in 2026. Wisconsin offers a look at what's at stake.

entry.title: In Dublin, tech workers raise concerns about AI
entry.summary: Dublin, Ireland, is a longtime hub for American tech companies. A group of workers held a summit to discuss their concerns about AI in Irish workplaces and life.

entry.title: Elizabeth Holmes documentary 'You Can See Everything' has audiences filling theaters
entry.summary: Theater owners are clamoring to book You Can See Everything in additional locations after a very successful opening weekend. It's had the second best opening ever for a non-music documentary.

entry.title: DOJ charges 28 in California with voting crimes as election tensions escalate
entry.summary: The DOJ also filed an emergency request in federal court to stop California from processing ballots returned by people on the voter rolls the federal government says are "likely noncitizens."

entry.title: The latest turn in the 89 years of looking for the singular Amelia Earhart
entry.summary: What is it about Amelia Earhart? Nearly 90 years after she and her plane disappeared, we check in with her hometown.

entry.title: Difficult times in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation of farmers
entry.summary: Many farmers across the U.S. are reaching retirement age. But lately, increasing volatility and sky-high prices in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation to take over.

entry.title: El Nino delays Magic: The Gathering trading cards
entry.summary: One of the unexpected consequences of the El Nino weather pattern causing drought at the Panama Canal has left Magic: The Gathering trading card enthusiasts hoping for better weather
